digest.component_or_area: fsck command suite and git utilities
propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but have no repair-specific logic and are imported by seven production modules across the codebase, creating an inverted dependency.
Moving the three primitives from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py (a stdlib-only leaf module) eliminates the inverted dependency and improves architectural clarity without introducing circular imports.

Compatibility surfaces in fsck.py and fsck_repair.py must be preserved through re-exports so that existing test patches binding these names as module attributes continue to resolve without editing test files.
The moved primitives preserve gitutil.py's property of having no module-level rebar.* imports; function-local imports of reducer._api._is_net_archived are maintained for _dir_is_archived.
